d: The strategic contest between Australia and China is intensifying in the Solomon Islands. The Pacific nation signed a security agreement with Beijing in 2022, giving China an important foothold close to Australia. But that pact is due to expire in April, and reports say the Solomon Islands will not renew it. Instead, a new security treaty with Australia is expected to be signed. The shift marks an important gain for Canberra after years of concern about China’s growing influence across the Pacific. But Beijing is far from out of the picture.
